correctness.rationale: For heterogeneous Neumann predator-prey reaction diffusion with positive equilibrium U,V and fixed A,B>0 satisfying AbU=BcV pointwise, the ground-state transform p=u/U,q=v/V converts diffusion to U^-2 div(U² grad p) and V analogue. Derivative of E=integral[A U² h(p)+B V² h(q)] cancels cross-reaction exactly and leaves strictly coercive reaction squares plus nonpositive Fisher terms. Logistic bounds, parabolic regularity, L² dissipation and uniform continuity imply uniform convergence for any strictly positive initial profiles. Symbolically verified cancellation and the explicit nonproportional U,V example with positive r, negative m.

originality.rationale: Weighted Lyapunov energies and global stability exist for competitive, delayed, or saturating predator-prey models. This finding isolates an exact pointwise matching condition for the specific two-species opposite-sign mass-action Neumann system, with arbitrary positive diffusion and separate nonconstant equilibrium profiles; no generic Hopf obstruction is claimed.

Existence of positive equilibrium with pointwise matching is assumed and not proved for arbitrary inputs.
